title: Single-judge review (one part of one ensemble judge)
description: What one judge writes for one packet (judge/packets/<judge>/part-NNN.json). Several parts of the same judge are merged by scripts/judge_combine.py; an item id reviewed twice by one judge is an input error. See references/judge-ensemble.md.

judge.description: panel member name, as in judges_config.json

model.description: model id of the judge (llm:<id>), or script:<name>

mode.description: host_sequential = the host model ran this judge as its own pass (independence is procedural); parallel = separate calls/models; deterministic = a script.

id.description: '<entity>|<label>' for items ('<term>|KeyTerm' for unlabeled key terms); causal id, chain id, or '<src_key>--<predicate>--<tgt_key>' for claims

suggestion.description: machine-usable fix within this judge's dimension only
